dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature on the trailing edge forming a falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape with a discernible pixel radius at the maximum vertical extent.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Posteriorly swept angle relative to the dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Horizontal base measurement is greater than the vertical height measurement.

anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Diminutive length and broad thickness relative to the cranial mass.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse transition angle located at the anterior melon boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Monochromatic cyan luminance across the entire visible surface.
